test_title: PYST 58: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). A sits second to the left of D, who is third to the left of E. C sits third to the right of G, who is not an immediate neighbour of E. B sits second to the right of G.

What is the position of B with respect to C?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

A sits second to the left of D, who is third to the left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62091618589f93970cde027d8a6ed6d9a7fd40db38942eed50e1e716ca349163.png] 

C sits third to the right of G, who is not an immediate neighbour of E. B sits second to the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f8f8e6c40372182c6c01cb5e77138dab85eec9d29e4db28e5fc07ac5d08a5a0.png] 

Thus, the position of B with respect to C is Immediate left of C.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
